Automatic tells them apart each time you scroll{seen, select, touchpad {, and took the last one for a touchpad} mouse {, and took the last one for a mouse} unseen {, and has not seen a scroll over the model yet} other {}}. Pick one if it guesses wrong. On Mouse a pinch pans too, as Ctrl with a wheel does.
prefs.scrolling.title: Scrolling
prefs.singleKeys.hint: Letter, digit and symbol keys on their own start tools and views, such as E for Extrude. Turn this off when voice control or screen reader browse mode types letters. Ctrl or Cmd chords, Escape, Delete, the F keys, the arrows and the command palette keep working.

prefs.smoothing.title: Smoothing
prefs.solid.hint: Panels, menus and the floating cards draw opaque instead of glass, so no model colour shows through behind their text. More and Maximum contrast turn it on.
prefs.solid.title: Solid panels
prefs.tangent.hint: Where two faces meet smoothly, like the borders of a fillet, there is no corner to see, only a line across one continuous surface.
